ai_review.review: The reviewer rates the performance highly, calling the songs "great" and praising the overall vibe. The recording is described as authentic, well balanced and “incredible,” suggesting an excellent audience capture with no noticeable flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 5‑star review, but it praises both the musical performance and the recording quality strongly; thus a high rating is warranted despite limited data.
